breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: An acute viral infection of the respiratory tract, occurring in isolated cases, in epidemics, or in pandemics; it is caused by serologically different strains of viruses (influenzaviruses) designated A, B, and C, has a 3-day incubation period, and usually lasts for 3 to 10 days. It is marked by inflammation of the nasal mucosa, pharynx, and conjunctiva; headache; myalgia; often fever, chills, and prostration; and occasionally involvement of the myocardium or central nervous system.

top_drugs.drug_name: INFLUENZA A VIRUS, INACTIVATED WHOLE VIRION

curated.category: 急性呼吸道感染 (Acute Respiratory Infection)
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 多数青壮年感染后1周内自愈；但高龄老人、婴幼儿、孕妇及慢阻肺/心血管基础病患者可在数日内进展为原发病毒性肺炎、继发细菌（金葡菌/肺炎链球菌）重症肺炎、ARDS及暴发性心肌炎致死，中国超额呼吸死亡80%以上发生在60岁及以上人群。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 发病48小时内尽早启用神经氨酸酶抑制剂（奥司他韦）或RNA聚合酶抑制剂（玛巴洛沙韦单剂口服）可显著缩短病程、抑制排毒并降低重症与住院风险；住院重症患者无论病程长短均应尽早抗病毒及器官支持。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO季节性流感实况估算全球每年约有290,000–650,000例与流感直接相关的呼吸系统死亡（此处取区间保守下限值290,000，未计心血管等非呼吸系统诱发死亡），全球年发约10亿例（其中300万–500万例为重症）。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 发表于Lancet Public Health的中国流感超额死亡研究估算全国平均每年约有88,100例流感相关呼吸系统超额死亡（80%以上为≥60岁老年人）；注意2024年国家疾控局被动法定登记流行性感冒8,417,396例、直接标注死因20例显著低估了慢病诱发超额死亡。
annual_deaths_china.source: Li et al., Lancet Public Health 2019 (PMID: 31493844) / NDCPA

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球每年约5%–10%成人和20%–30%儿童感染季节性流感，总计约10亿人次发病，温带地区呈显著冬春季高峰。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国2023–2024年高发季就诊量与法定报告例数跃居乙丙类呼吸道传染病前列，甲型H1N1/H3N2与乙型Victoria交替主导流行。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 临床高危或重症表现（持续高热>3天、剧烈咳嗽咳脓血痰、呼吸频率增快、低氧血症SpO2<93%、神志异常或心肌酶急升）立即住院并行甲乙流核酸/抗原确诊，不等待结果即启动抗病毒治疗（首选奥司他韦75mg bid或玛巴洛沙韦，危重静脉不能口服可用帕拉米韦）；高度警惕继发MRSA/肺炎链球菌坏死性肺炎并及时联合抗菌；发生呼吸衰竭按CAP/ARDS方案行HFNC、无创或机械通气乃至ECMO救治。

breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。

master.definition_en: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 4B1 (CMT4B1) is a subtype of Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 4 characterized by an early childhood-onset of severe, demyelinating sensorimotor neuropathy, various degrees of complex myelin outfoldings seen on peripheral nerve biopsy, very slow, and often undetectable, nerve conduction velocities, and the typical CMT phenotype (i.e. distal muscle weakness and atrophy, sensory loss, and frequent pes cavus). Other reported features include facial weakness, vocal cord paresis, respiratory difficulties, and skeletal deformities (e.g. chest deformities, claw hands, pes equinovarus).
synonyms_en: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 4 caused by mutation in MTMR2
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

master.definition_en: Birk-Barel syndrome is an inherited condition characterized by intellectual disability, hypotonia, hyperactivity, and unusual facial features. The condition is caused by mutations in the KCNK9 gene on chromosome 8. This condition demonstrates dominant inheritance with paternal imprinting, which means that a mutation in the maternal gene will result in disease, but a mutation in the paternal gene will have no effect (imprinted with paternal silencing).

master.definition_en: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as EZB with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. This is based on a combination of genetic features and EZB DLBCLs often, but do not always, have hot spot mutations in EZH2 and/or a BCL2 translocation. This class can be further subdivided into two sub-classes EZB-MYC+ and EZB-MYC- using the double hit gene expression signature (DHITsig). This subgroup also commonly has mutations due to aberrant somatic hypermutation affecting IRF8, which can be coding or non-coding.

master.definition_en: A rare autosomal recessive distal hereditary motor neuropathy caused by a mutation in the COQ7 gene, characterized by severe, slowly progressive, symmetric distal muscle weakness and atrophy of the limbs predominantly due to length-dependent peripheral motor neuropathy. Both the lower and upper limbs are affected, with a lower-limb predominance at onset. Patients present with walking difficulties and frequent falls. Pes cavus may also be present. Sensory abnormalities are usually absent, or mild when present.
